name: do-break-before-write
source: const old={run(){}};const clean={run(){}};const box={api:old};async function run(){const info=await window.desktopApi.app.getInfo();do{if(info.hasEnum)break;box.api=clean;}while(false);const alias=box.api;alias.outsideScope=window.desktopApi.outsideScope;window.BankStatementController.createBankStatementController({api:old});return alias===old;}run();
